## Hypothesis

We aim to improve edge capture on J's winner days while minimizing losses on loser days by adjusting the shotgun_scalper's exit parameters (TP, stop, time stop, chandelier arm) and adding a volume filter. The hypothesis is that a 75% TP1, 35% stop, 12-minute time stop, 60% chandelier arm, and volume ratio threshold of 1.2 will better capture the asymmetric payoff of J's structure.

## Mechanism

Enter on the shotgun_scalper signal (defined in stage5 grinder logic). Exit triggers:  
- TP1 at +75% premium gain (sell 2/3 position)  
- Stop at -35% premium loss (catastrophe cap; chart stop is primary invalidation per doctrine)  
- Time stop at 12 minutes  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% of favorable move, trails 15% off high-water mark  
- Entry requires volume ratio > 1.2 (current bar volume / 20-bar average volume)
